blocks.name: get_ip_kb_list_map

inputs.name: playbook
inputs.value:
`---
- name: Get Windows System Info
  hosts: windows
  gather_facts: no

  tasks:
    - name: Detect if mirror VM details are missing
      set_fact:
        mirror_missing: >-
          {{
            hostvars.get('mirror_vm') is not defined or
            hostvars['mirror_vm'].mirror_vm_private_ip is not defined or
            hostvars['mirror_vm'].mirror_user is not defined or
            hostvars['mirror_vm'].mirror_password is not defined
          }}

    - name: Get system info
      win_shell: |
        $os = Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion"
        $info = [PSCustomObject]@{
          ProductName = $os.ProductName
          DisplayVersion = $os.DisplayVersion
          Architecture = $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE
          HostName = $env:COMPUTERNAME
        }
        $info | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
      register: win_info
      args:
        executable: powershell
      when: mirror_missing

    - name: Get private IP 
      win_shell: |
        (Get-NetIPConfiguration |
          Where-Object {
            $_.IPv4Address -and
            $_.NetAdapter.Status -eq 'Up' -and
            (
              $_.IPv4Address.IPAddress -like '10.*' -or
              $_.IPv4Address.IPAddress -like '172.1[6-9].*' -or
              $_.IPv4Address.IPAddress -like '172.2[0-9].*' -or
              $_.IPv4Address.IPAddress -like '172.3[0-1].*' -or
              $_.IPv4Address.IPAddress -like '192.168.*'
            )
          } |
          Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty IPv4Address
        ).IPAddress
      register: win_private_ip
      args:
        executable: powershell
      failed_when: false
      when: mirror_missing
    
    - name: Get public IP
      win_shell: |
        try {
          Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.ipify.org"
        } catch {
          Write-Output ""
        }
      register: win_public_ip
      args:
        executable: powershell
      failed_when: false
      when: mirror_missing

    - name: Get local IPv4
      win_shell: |
        (Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -InterfaceOperationalStatus Up |
        Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notlike '169.254*' -and $_.IPAddress -notlike '127.*' } |
        Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty IPAddress)
      register: win_local_ip
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Set windows system info facts
      set_fact:
        product_name: "{{ (win_info.stdout | from_json).ProductName }}"
        windows_display_version: "{{ (win_info.stdout | from_json).DisplayVersion | default('') }}"
        arch_raw: "{{ (win_info.stdout | from_json).Architecture | lower }}"
        host_name: "{{ (win_info.stdout | from_json).HostName | default('') }}"
      when: mirror_missing

    - name: Normalize architecture
      set_fact:
        architecture: >-
          {{ (
              'x64' if arch_raw in ['amd64','x64','x86_64'] else
              'x86' if arch_raw == 'x86' else
              'arm64' if arch_raw in ['arm64','aarch64'] else
              arch_raw
          ) }}
      when: mirror_missing

    - name: Show final system info
      debug:
        msg:
          product_name: "{{ product_name | default('') }}"
          display_version: "{{ windows_display_version | default('') }}"
          architecture: "{{ architecture | default('') }}"
          host_name: "{{ host_name | default('') }}"
          private_ip_address: "{{win_private_ip.stdout | default('')}}"
          public_ip_address: "{{win_public_ip.stdout | default('')}}"
          local_ip: "{{win_local_ip.stdout | default('')}}"
      when: mirror_missing
`

blocks.name: parse_system_info
